operations.name: read_rng_data
operations.desc: Read 4 bytes of random data from VirtIO RNG device
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov edx, 0xc080
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_device_status
operations.desc: Read device status register at offset 0x70 in configuration space
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov edx, 0xc0f0
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: check_device_features
operations.desc: Query device features at offset 0x04 in configuration space
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov edx, 0xc084
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_interrupt_status
operations.desc: Read interrupt status register at offset 0x13 in configuration space
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov edx, 0xc093
in al, dx
zero eax high byte
ret

operations.name: read_queue_size
operations.desc: Read queue size indicator at offset 0x12 in configuration space
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov edx, 0xc092
in ax, dx
zero eax high word
ret
